name: Char Hearth
description: Bank Char to strengthen Browning, flare at full capacity, or cash out a Blaze at 110°C+.

residues.name: Banked Embers
residues.text: Every furnace burn costs 0.15 / 0.10 presence instead of 0.20. Overflow points gain ×1.75 / ×2.5.

residues.name: Coal Keeper
residues.text: Begin each new chapter with +2 / +4 Char, capped at 6. Full-six Blaze points gain ×1.5 / ×2.

objective.text: Spend all 6 Char in a Blaze.

residues.name: Red Glaze
residues.text: With 3+ banked Char, Browning bonus points gain ×1.5 / ×2. This multiplies the furnace’s banked-Char boost.

residues.name: Ash Memory
residues.text: Every Blaze returns 1 / 2 Char immediately after spending the bank. Returned Char can strengthen this bowl’s Browning with a furnace.

objective.text: Spend a total of 10 Char on Blaze or cool protection.

cards.name: Smokeleaf
cards.text: Oldest furnace burns 0.20 of the oldest eligible Protein presence at 90°C+ to gain 1 Char. Banked Char multiplies Browning by 1 + 0.20 × Char. At 6 Char, further burns flare for 120 points instead. At 110°C+, spend 3–6 Char on a Blaze worth 60 points per Char.

cards.name: Soot Pepper
cards.text: Alternative furnace: at 90°C+, burn 0.20 Protein presence for 1 Char, or a 120-point Overflow at the cap of 6. Only the oldest furnace burns. Banked Char strengthens Browning; 110°C+ cashes out 3+ Char in a Blaze. Aromatic pairs with Fat for Infusion at 40–100°C.

cards.name: Marrow Scrap
cards.text: Protein feeds the oldest furnace at 90°C+, losing 0.20 presence before scoring (less with Banked Embers). Pair with Sugar for Browning at 70–110°C: each banked Char adds 20% to that reaction while a live furnace remains.

cards.name: Old Bean
cards.text: Protein and Sugar can activate Browning at 70–110°C without another ingredient. A furnace can burn this Bean to build Char, which strengthens Browning, but the presence cost reduces both of this card’s properties.

cards.name: Ash Dumpling
cards.text: The oldest Dumpling scores 25 × banked Char × its presence every serving, at any heat. This does not spend Char. A 110°C+ Blaze spends the bank first, so keep heat at 105°C or lower to keep earning the stored-Char bonus.

cards.name: Cinder Bean
cards.text: At 40–60°C, spend 1 Char to retain 96% presence on both the oldest other furnace and the oldest other Protein ingredient. Protects up to two distinct ingredients, even in the 3 L pot; does nothing if neither target exists.

cards.name: Ember Truffle
cards.text: While operational, a Blaze at 110°C+ scores 80 per Char instead of 60; copies do not stack. A Blaze needs at least 3 Char and spends the whole bank after this turn’s furnace burn. Aromatic also supports Infusion, which stops above 100°C.

cards.name: Smoke Pear
cards.text: While operational, Overflow flares score ×1.5: 180 points before residue bonuses. At 90°C+, Overflow requires a live furnace, eligible Protein and a bank already at 6 Char before burning. Sugar supports Browning; Aromatic supports Infusion.
